hourly_automation_rule: Update market JSON only; never rewrite UI files or VERSION.

deployment.pages: Directly upload committed public/ with no brittle verification gate.
deployment.hourly_data: market-radar-control.yml commits JSON and deploys Pages in the same workflow.
deployment.cycle_history: cycle-history.yml rebuilds historical cycle data and deploys Pages in the same workflow.
deployment.android: Capacitor syncs public/, applies native icon/back fallback, then Gradle builds APK.

cycle_history.history_span: maximum available daily history from the data source
shows: all completed historical start/end dates recent-first
cycle_history.warning: Historical averages are descriptive comparisons, not a forecast of the next turning date.

cache_rule: Any user-visible release below VERSION means stale cache/deploy failure.
sw.js stores nothing and unregisters after deleting caches.
stable-v034.html uses a new filename so old latest.html cache cannot satisfy it.
app-runtime-v34 never auto-reloads an incomplete screen into a blank page.
android_back_contract: Open detail/modal -> hardware Back closes it.
